indicators.description: Package name matches a demo test-threat record in the signed offline threat pack. This is the controlled benign VillainCaller sample, not real malware.
Signing certificate matches the demo test-threat signer in the signed offline threat pack. The certificate belongs to the controlled VillainCaller demo sample.
Installed base APK digest matches the demo test-threat record byte-for-byte (base APK only; splits are not hashed).
DISABLED negative control: proves disabled indicators never match. If GoodCaller is ever flagged by threat intelligence, this record was wrongly evaluated.
Enabled negative control with a digest that matches nothing: proves the scanner matches values, not mere presence in the pack.
FUTURE-typed record: representable in the schema but never evaluated by this build.

Outbound destination matches a controlled demo network indicator in the signed offline threat pack. 203.0.113.0/24 is RFC 5737 TEST-NET-3 documentation space — this is a demonstration indicator, not real malware infrastructure.
Enabled network negative control: a TEST-NET address the demo probe never targets, proving destination matching is exact.
